mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hospital_all_list ( hospital_name, hospital_addr, hospital_class_code, hospital_class_name, hospital_site, hospital_tel, hospital_lon, hospital_lat, yoyang_giho, sidocode, sidocode_name, sigungu_code, sigungu_code_name, eupmyeon, open_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{h_name}, #{h_addr}, #{h_class}, #{h_class_name}, #{h_site}, #{h_tel}, #{h_lon}, #{h_lat}, #{h_ykiho}, #{h_sidoCD}, #{h_sidoCdNm}, #{h_sgguCd}, #{h_sgguCdNm}, #{h_emdongNm}, #{h_estbDd}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hospital_addr = #{h_addr}, hospital_class_code = #{h_class}, hospital_class_name = #{h_class_name}, hospital_site = #{h_site}, hospital_lon = #{h_lon}, hospital_lat = #{h_lat}, yoyang_giho = #{h_ykiho}, sidocode = #{h_sidoCD}, sidocode_name = #{h_sidoCdNm}, sigungu_code = #{h_sgguCd}, sigungu_code_name = #{h_sgguCdNm}, eupmyeon = #{h_emdongNm}, open_date = #{h_estbDd}, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO hospital_all_list ( hospital_name, hospital_addr, hospital_class_code, hospital_class_name, hospital_site, hospital_tel, hospital_lon, hospital_lat, yoyang_giho, sidocode, sidocode_name, sigungu_code, sigungu_code_name, eupmyeon, open_date, created_at ) VALUES ( #{h_name}, #{h_addr}, #{h_class}, #{h_class_name}, #{h_site}, #{h_tel}, #{h_lon}, #{h_lat}, #{h_ykiho}, #{h_sidoCD}, #{h_sidoCdNm}, #{h_sgguCd}, #{h_sgguCdNm}, #{h_emdongNm}, #{h_estbDd}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hospital_class_code = #{h_class}, hospital_class_name = #{h_class_name}, hospital_lon = #{h_lon}, hospital_lat = #{h_lat}, yoyang_giho = #{h_ykiho}, sidocode = #{h_sidoCD}, sidocode_name = #{h_sidoCdNm}, sigungu_code = #{h_sgguCd}, sigungu_code_name = #{h_sgguCdNm}, eupmyeon = #{h_emdongNm}, open_date = #{h_estbDd}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT a.hospital_name, a.hospital_class_code, a.sidocode, a.hospital_addr, a.hospital_lon, a.hospital_lat, a.hospital_tel, a.yoyang_giho, left(a.sidocode,2) as sidocodetwo FROM hospital_all_list as a WHERE 1=1 and a.old_hid is null and a.hospital_class_code in ('01',11,21 ) ORDER BY a.hospital_cid ASC
SELECT count(*) as cnt,count(*)+1 as newNo FROM hospital as a WHERE SUBSTRING(a.hid, 2, 2) = #{h_class_code} and SUBSTRING(a.hid, 7, 2) = #{h_sidocodetwo} and SUBSTRING(a.hid, 4, 2) = 'KR' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hospital ( hid, baseName, shortName, address, lon, lat, telephone, yoyang_giho, createAt ) VALUES ( #{new_hid}, #{h_name}, #{h_name}, #{h_address}, #{h_lon}, #{h_lat}, #{h_tel}, #{h_ykiho}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE shortName = #{h_name}, address = #{h_address}, telephone = #{h_tel}, lon = #{h_lon}, lat = #{h_lat}, updateAt = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM hospital as a WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY a.hid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hospital_alias ( hid, standard_name, alias_name, created_at ) VALUES ( #{h_hid}, #{h_name}, #{h_alias_name}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hid = #{h_hid}, updated_at = NOW()
